integrity: Proof and exact equations supplied in RESULT.md; reproducible finite checking via verify.py; no claim of independent audit or publication priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to the indicated permutation quadratic map and fixed initial data off absorbing boundary states. The exact norm is an operator rate, not an orbitwise rate for every initial condition. General stochastic perturbations are not covered. A closely titled 2023 article has inaccessible full text and remains an originality priority risk. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Exact two-clock relaxation and Poisson boundary windows for permutation quadratic stochastic maps
